gen-gf-underdog-gf-spinnaker: Underdog draws every curve with one unvarying pen line, its c flung open like a horseshoe. Spinnaker follows in a light, modern sans whose apertures keep each counter connected to the space outside, so long paragraphs feel breathable.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-trispace: Trispace sets its letters sparse and wide, curves opening outward. Underdog shouts above in uniform, unshaded strokes, and the plain sans underneath gives that loud display face room to speak without crowding it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Tsukimi Rounded reads softly, its round forms curving like open parentheses. Underdog's unshaded, horseshoe-mouthed display letters make the stronger statement, but both share a love of smooth, parallel-edged curves that run without a kink.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tuffy: Underdog's most striking habit is a c opened wide like a horseshoe, drawn with no change in pressure. Tuffy keeps that pencil-like uniformity going in sans-serif form, and its widely parted s lets text sit comfortably beneath the headline.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-varta: Bent pipe cleaner, basically. Varta takes over for the text as a sans-serif with big open eyes on every e and a, so a long page of it stays easy to follow.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-vazirmatn: Vazirmatn is the body here, a sans-serif with a wide-open s that never tightens. Underdog is best at heavy, uniform display strokes where horizontals match verticals, while Vazirmatn does its best work in friendly, approachable text.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text reads cleanly, its open terminals making each word easy to catch. And since Underdog's bowls are as heavy as its stems, give the body size a little extra room so it holds its own.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau: Underdog brings uniform, toothpaste-squeezed strokes and a horseshoe c up top. Ysabeau sweeps below as a plain sans whose curves never close up, giving the heading's heft a lighter, friendlier partner.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau-infant: Steady, unshaded outlines with a horseshoe c. And Underdog earns its keep when set big and short, while the sans below it lets its terminals flick outward like tongs.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office reads with an open-ended look on every curved letter, modern and light. And Underdog, lacking any thick-thin pulse, leaves the sans below to carry the eye gently through a long passage.
